claim_1.claim: RNA sequencing analysis of CD4+ CD8+ double-positive T cells from 88 dengue patients showed 20 differentially expressed genes between CD4+ CD8+ DP and CD8+ SP cells, with similar expression profiles in patients with and without plasma leakage.

sources.quote: Overall, there were 20 DE genes (absolute log 2 fold change (FC) > 2, and adjusted p -value (false discovery rate, FDR) < 0.05) identified between CD4 + CD8 + DP and CD8 + SP T cells.
CD4 + CD8 + DP T cells isolated from both D+L and D-L groups displayed very similar gene expression profiles and clustered closely to one another based on UMAP analysis.

comparison.finding: 20 differentially expressed genes between CD4+ CD8+ DP and CD8+ SP cells
